productionIntegrationFinding.reason: The current production V10 balanced baseline is materially stronger than the research Fast baseline used to train Directed Generation V2. Layering Directed P13 after the balanced path is mostly redundant; moving a Fast-first early return ahead of V10 violates the equal-board remnant objective on the replay sample.

safeRound0PrototypeReplay.cohort: 24 deterministic cases, source-balanced, pieceQty <= 50, types <= 20, reference-area gap=1 and Directed policy eligible

fastFirstCertifiedProbe.finding: Fast lower-bound certification is insufficient for early return because objective #2 can regress even when objective #1 is certified.

cheapCertifiedPolishProbe.finding: Cheap polish reduces but does not eliminate the remnant regression, so it cannot be promoted under the frozen no-regression objective.

decision.nextMilestone: Design a directed generator against the actual production objective tuple (boards, then remnant quality) or move the synchronous production architecture to a Fast-first cascade only after a remnant-safe certificate exists.
